source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Topic 5.2.2 (PDF 128-129, printed 125-126).

blocks.text: Descriptive statistics data ki summary (khulasa) banane aur use organize karne (tarteeb se rakhne) ke liye istemal hoti hain. Har qeemat alag alag dekhne ki bajaye yeh overall picture (poori tasveer) dikhati hain.
Misal: College ke 10 students ne maths ka exam diya aur un ke scores yeh hain: 50, 65, 75, 80, 85, 90, 95, 60, 70 aur 88.

items: Mean (average, ausat): sab scores jama kar ke students ki ginti (10) se divide karte hain.
Sab se zyada aur sab se kam score: sab se zyada 95 aur sab se kam 50.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mean 75.5 likhti hai. Das scores ka jama 758 hai, is liye mean 758 ÷ 10 = 75.8 hai.
Yeh saada hisab har score ko alag dekhe baghair jaldi bata deta hai ke students ne kaisa kiya.

blocks.prompt: Data ko graph ya chart ki shakal dena (visualize karna) descriptive statistics samajhne mein kaise madad deta hai? (Short question 4)
blocks.explanation: Chart ek nazar mein woh dikhata hai jo numbers ki summary batati hai: histogram dikhata hai ke zyada qeematein kahan hain aur kitni phaili hain, boxplot median, quartiles aur outliers (baqi se bohat alag qeematein) dikhata hai, aur bar ya line chart averages ka comparison (muqabla) ya trend (kis taraf ja raha hai) dikhata hai. Is tarah patterns aur ajeeb (unusual) qeematein har number parhe baghair nazar aa jati hain.

items: Descriptive statistics data ki summary banati hain: das scores ka mean 75.8 (kitab: 75.5), sab se zyada 95, sab se kam 50.
